ModMetaData.name: GTI Marine Armor Materials [1.0->1.6]
ModMetaData.author: joe_the_tech (GTI personal fork, maintained by WarezCrawler)
ModMetaData.description:
Personal GTI fork of "Marine Armor Materials" by joe_the_tech, updated for RimWorld 1.6.
This is a simple mod that allows you to choose what metal a suit of marine (power) armor is made of, and scales the armor's attributes to that of the material. Vanilla marine armor is made with plasteel, so the original author balanced this mod against that. The results are that this mod makes plasteel marine armor a little more powerful, but you're not unstoppable. However, it also allows you to make marine armor out of any metal you want, including those introduced by mods.
Compatibility: - This mod is NOT compatible with saved games that you've already built marine armor in. - This mod is NOT compatible with other mods that change the vanilla power armor. - - Exception: This mod has been patched to be compatible with Vanilla Armour Expanded. - This mod is compatible with all other mods.
